title: The T tool reads Title on a video
goal: On a video the tool you press T for is still called Text, while the title walkthrough mock calls it the Title tool (its tooltip reads Title / Text). A video editor looking for a title tool should find it by that name. Name it Title on a document with time and keep Text on a picture.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-title-wt.html ~132 `<button class="tool" id="tTitle" title="Title / Text (T)">`, steps ~415 'Pick up the Title tool'. App: Sources/Photonz/ToolGroupButton.swift ~40 and Sources/Photonz/EditorView.swift ~1498 return "Text" for .text in every document. The name should follow the document (hasTime), not the release, so it is shared code; no flag needed. Keep the playtest control names stable or add the new one alongside (Scripts/playtest/*.json grep '"Text"'). Found by the manager pass's mock comparison 2026-10-07.
acceptance: On a document with time the T tool's tooltip reads 'Title / Text (T)', and its name in the tool bar's flyout and in any menu row that names the tool says Title
On a picture with no time everything still says Text, unchanged
Walks that find the tool by name still pass (search the walks for the tool's name and update or alias them)
Try path at Next defaults: open the talk sample, rest the pointer on the T tool, read the tooltip. Audit written under queue/audits/
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: owns these walks: video-tool-bar-walk, t-tool-says-text-on-a-picture-walk, one-glass-tool-bar-walk, tool-bar-fills-its-room-walk, tutorial-a-title-that-moves-walk

Reproduced at HEAD: video-tool-bar-walk's toolBar probe listed slots [Select, Blade, Text, ...] on the sample recording; tooltip code already said Title / Text but the More menu, Edit > Tools, the under-More note and the title guide's first card all said Text.

Adversarial review before: a Final Cut/Premiere editor looks for a Title tool; the mock names it Title in its menu row and tooltip Title / Text (T). Risk: the name flipping between windows; kept it to the bar's own condition (a document with time on Next's video tool bar, the same condition that already put Title / Text in the tip), so Current and pictures are untouched. Walks that name the slot updated to Title.

Built: PhotonzCore ToolName (tested, ToolNameTests) is the one rule; EditorState.hasVideoToolBar is the one condition; EditorView slot names, More rows, probes, under-More note, EditorCommands Edit > Tools row, TutorialController card subject, and the a-title-that-moves guide step (Pick the Title tool) all read it.

Found while verifying: no tooltip on a video's bar could be read or photographed by any walk, because walks keep a video's window at alpha 0 and the tooltip copies its window's alpha (instrumented: show() ran, panelAlpha=0, winAlpha=0). Not an app bug: a person's window is opaque. Fixed in the harness: visibleDescription counts a tip over an invisible window, and the snapshot lifts the tip with the window. Video walk now reads 'Title / Text (T) above at (522, 427) 87x31' and photographs it.

Verified: Scripts/test.sh 11756 tests pass; walks green: video-tool-bar, t-tool-says-text-on-a-picture (new), one-glass-tool-bar, tool-bar-fills-its-room, tutorial-a-title-that-moves, notices-say-what-happened, marquee-answers-to-m, history-tooltips. All at Next defaults, no flags.

left rough (no task, under the bar): VoiceOver reads the video bar's T button as 'Title / Text' (the tip's words) rather than 'Title'; a picture walk not in front sees Edit > Tools rows dimmed, so the picture walk reads the menu and picks with T instead of choosing the row.

On a video (Next video tool bar, Next defaults) the T tool is named Title on the bar, in More, Edit > Tools, the under-More note and the title guide card; tooltip reads Title / Text (T) per the mock; pictures still say Text. Rule in PhotonzCore ToolName (ToolNameTests). Harness now reads/photographs tooltips over a walk's hidden video window. Verified: Scripts/test.sh 11756 pass; walks video-tool-bar, t-tool-says-text-on-a-picture (new), one-glass-tool-bar, tool-bar-fills-its-room, tutorial-a-title-that-moves, notices-say-what-happened, marquee-answers-to-m, history-tooltips green.
